ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Taiwan's governing statutory regime: (1) Money Laundering Control Act (2018 consolidated version), Arts. 2, 5, 6, 8, 10, 12-1; (2) Counter-Terrorism Financing Act (2016), Arts. 3 and 5; (3) Company Act §22-1 (2018 amendment) and the supporting 'Regulations Governing the Registration of Significant Beneficial Owners of Companies and Limited Partnerships' (2018), which mandate UBO declarations for any direct/indirect ownership or control at or above 25%; (4) Investment Commission (MOEA) 'Review and Approval Regulations for Mainland-Area Investment in Taiwan' and post-establishment filing rules under the Statute for Investment by Foreign Nationals / Mainland Area residents.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized PRC Parent Company Business License and Certificate of Incorporation (Chinese-language, with Chinese company seal)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) of P.R.C. / local Municipal Market Regulation Administration
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Cross-Strait Consular Legalization procedure via ARATS and SEF (Hague Apostille not accepted by Taiwan; TECO consular legalization alternative)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Parent Company Articles of Association / Memorandum and All Amendments

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Cross-Strait Consular Legalization via ARATS and SEF

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board Resolution of Parent Company approving incorporation of Taiwan subsidiary, designated capital contribution, and appointment of first local director and UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Parent Company Board of Directors; notarized in P.R.C.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Company Law of the People's Republic of China (2023 Revision, effective 1 July 2024), Articles 23-35 (incorporation), 36-47 (organizational structure), 48-56 (executive responsibilities); Foreign Investment Law of the PRC (2019), Articles 2, 4, 29-31, 42; Regulations on the Administration of Market Entity Registration (State Council Order No. 746, 2021), Articles 3, 8-12, 17; Measures for the Administration of Foreign Investment Information Reporting (MOFCOM Order No. 2, 2019), Articles 3, 7-8; Special Administrative Measures (Negative List) for Foreign Investment Access (2022 Edition), Items 13 and 14 (value-added telecommunications - not triggered by pure software development).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) and the local Municipal/Provincial Market Regulation Administration at the company's registered address - Foreign-Invested Enterprise (WFOE) registration window.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Market Entity Establishment Registration - Foreign-Invested Enterprise (市场主体设立登记申请书) filed through the 'one-network' e-government portal (一网通办).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: PRC Company Law adopts a subscription capital system (认缴制); no statutory minimum paid-up capital applies to an ISIC 6201 software-development WFOE, and the 2022 Foreign Investment Negative List does not restrict this sector. The Articles of Association must state the subscribed capital and a contribution schedule; no escrow account, bank verification certificate, or paid-up capital deposit is required at incorporation. The sole shareholder must remit the subscribed capital within the contractual contribution period to satisfy bank KYC reviews and subsequent operational fundings.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the registered capital be subscribed by the sole shareholder per the Articles of Association, and management is authorized to open bank accounts for contribution remittances; RESOLVED, that the Company's registered office at [lease address] be approved as the statutory domicile for legal and tax purposes; RESOLVED FURTHER, that [Name] be appointed Executive Director and Legal Representative, [Name] Supervisor, and [Name] General Manager, each with the powers set out in the Articles of Association; RESOLVED, that the appointed officers are authorized, individually, to sign all incorporation applications, leases, bank forms, and filings with the Market Regulation Administration, tax authorities, SAFE, MIIT, and other agencies necessary to complete the incorporation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Enterprise Name Pre-Approval (名称自主申报)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: SAMR National Enterprise Name Registration System, accessed via the provincial 'one-network' e-government portal (一网通办).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit an online enterprise name autonomous declaration: format [Administrative Region] + [Trade Name] + [Industry Descriptor: Video Game Software Technology] + [Corporate Form: Limited Liability Company]. The system performs a national duplicate and prohibited-word check. Obtain the Name Pre-Approval Notice (企业名称保留通知书), valid for two calendar months; the notice may be stored electronically and cited in the subsequent registration application.
required_dossiers: Enterprise name autonomous declaration form
Identity proof or certification of the sole shareholder (Taiwan entity or individual)
Authorized agent's identification and power of attorney
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the system rejects the name for similarity to an existing software firm, re-submit with two or three alternative trade names; if rejection persists, request a manual name examination and administrative review at the local SAMR window, which must be completed within 10 working days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Cross-Strait Notarization and Verification of Investor Standing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Straits Exchange Foundation (SEF, Taipei) / Association for Relations across the Taiwan Strait (ARATS) notification procedure, coordinated with the notarial association and local notary in the PRC.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The Taiwan investor must procure notarized certification of its company registration certificate (公司登记证明书) or individual identity papers from a Taiwan notary; the notarized copy is transmitted through SEF and verified via the ARATS channel before delivery to the PRC notary office. All documents require a Chinese translation; no apostille is required because of the cross-strait notarization verification agreement.
required_dossiers: Notarized Taiwan company registration extract (issued within the last 3 months)
Notarized list of the Taiwan entity's directors and shareholders
SEF/ARATS verification letter
Chinese translations of each notarized document
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the verification correspondence is delayed, request a 15-day document supplement extension from SAMR; if the notary office reports a seal or false-document discrepancy, re-execute the notarization with the correct Taiwan registry extract and re-run the SEF-ARATS verification before the SAMR suspension period expires.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of WFOE Establishment Registration and Filing of Foreign Investment Information
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Municipal Market Regulation Administration (Foreign-Invested Enterprise window) and MOFCOM online Foreign Investment Information Reporting portal.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the Market Entity Establishment Registration application with the supporting corporate governance documents, confirming that the business scope (game anti-cheat middleware, software R&D, technical services, licensing) is not on the 2022 Foreign Investment Negative List; simultaneously submit the Foreign Investment Information Report (外商投资信息报告) electronically as required under MOFCOM Order No. 2/2019. Upon approval, the registry issues the integrated Business License (营业执照) containing the unified social credit code with tax, statistics, and social-insurance registration integration.
required_dossiers: Market Entity Establishment Registration application form
Articles of Association (Chinese version)
Enterprise name pre-approval notice
Notarized and verified investor credentials from Step 2
Lease agreement and property ownership certificate for the registered office
Appointment instruments for Legal Representative, Executive Director, and Supervisor
Foreign Investment Information Report (electronic form)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: On a one-time deficiency notice (一次性告知), cure by providing the missing documents within 15 working days; if the Negative List screening flags a related value-added telecom activity, amend the Articles of Association to delete the restricted activity and keep pure software-licensing scope; if registration is refused, initiate administrative reconsideration before the superior SAMR or re-file with a modified capital and scope structure.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Seal Carving, Tax Activation, and Social Insurance Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Public Security Bureau public seal filing desk, Municipal Taxation Bureau (electronic tax bureau), Social Insurance Administration, and Housing Fund Management Center.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After obtaining the Business License, engage a licensed engraving shop to produce the company seal, finance seal, legal representative seal, contract seal, and invoice seal, with mandatory public-security filing; complete taxpayer identity activation (实名办税) using the unified social credit code and register the tax accounting method; social insurance, occupational injury, and housing fund accounts become active through automated data exchange, and the first employee must be enrolled within 30 days of establishment.
required_dossiers: Business License (original and duplicate)
Legal Representative identification document
Public-security seal filing registration form
Articles of Association
Appointment resolutions for Legal Representative and Finance Officer
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the tax authority does not auto-activate files, a supplementary in-person tax registration at the tax hall is processed same-day using the unified social credit code; if the seal engraving shop refuses service due to a record mismatch, submit a written application to the local public security seal-administration unit for direct filing and re-order the engraving from a licensed vendor.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Bank Account Opening and SAFE Foreign Exchange Registration (FIRC)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed domestic commercial bank (delegated by the State Administration of Foreign Exchange - SAFE) and the local SAFE branch.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open the basic deposit account (基本存款账户) at a commercial bank; for the Taiwan shareholder's inbound capital contribution remitted in USD or TWD, the bank performs the WFOE Foreign Exchange Registration (境内直接投资外汇登记) on the SAFE capital-projects system, verifies the Business License and Articles, and opens a capital account settlement account (资本金结算账户); record SWIFT wires through the bank and complete the bank's beneficial-ownership KYC questionnaire.
required_dossiers: Business License with unified social credit code
Articles of Association and capital contribution schedule
Notarized and verified Taiwan investor documents from Step 2
Legal Representative and Supervisor identification documents
Reserved seal cards for all company seals
Beneficial Ownership Statement and Taiwan corporate group chart
Basic deposit account opening application
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank refuses to complete FIRC due to an incomplete beneficial-ownership chain, submit a supplemental BO declaration identifying the natural-person controllers of the Taiwan entity; if SAFE raises a data mismatch on the capital item, apply through the designated bank for a corrective amendment to the foreign exchange registration within 15 working days; if the first institution remains uncooperative, the company may open a second reserve bank account under a separate legal assessment.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (MIIT) - sectoral supervisor for software and information technology services; local cyberspace administration for network security policies. No pre-market industrial license is imposed on pure ISIC 6201 / NAICS 541511 anti-cheat middleware development.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not required - the general Business License authorizes software R&D, licensing, and technical services; an optional 'Software Enterprise Certification' (软件企业证书) and 'Software Product Registration' (软件产品登记) may be obtained voluntarily for tax super-deduction and VAT refund benefits under the dual-soft (双软) regime, but these are tax facilitation certificates, not operating permits. If the anti-cheat module incorporates cryptographic functions subject to the Commercial Cryptography Law (2020), a separate cryptography-product classification review is triggered at product launch and is not a formation-stage license condition.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Ecology and Environment (MEE) of the PRC and the Municipal Ecology and Environment Bureau at the registered office.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category III - Non-Project Filing (备案) / Exempt from full EIA report: software R&D in a leased office suite involves no construction production line, no wastewater-generating processes, and no VOC-emitting operations; under the 2021 Classification List of Environmental Impact Assessment for Construction Projects, office-only tenants are not required to prepare an EIA Report or Report Form; a simplified online filing may be triggered only if significant fit-out renovation occurs or the site is within an ecologically sensitive control zone.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Domestic sanitary wastewater discharged to the municipal sewer must meet the municipal sewer access limits referenced to Integrated Wastewater Discharge Standard GB 8978-1996 (Grade 3); no industrial wastewater is generated. Standby generator and boiler emissions, if any, must comply with GB 16297-1996 regulated pollutant concentration limits. Electronic waste and spent printer cartridges must be transferred through a qualified recycler with a waste manifest and reported to the municipal solid-waste information system; office hazardous waste (batteries, lithium cells) must be segregated and delivered to municipal hazardous-waste collection points, with no hazardous-waste processing license required for the WFOE itself.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety: the lessor must supply the building fire-protection acceptance certificate (建设工程消防验收合格证明); for the WFOE's occupancy, a pre-use fire-safety inspection/registration must be completed at the district fire rescue brigade if the office exceeds 300 square meters of public-use premises; the workplace must maintain fire extinguishers, smoke alarms, emergency lighting, and evacuation signage with quarterly inspection logs. Structural: the light office load (not exceeding 3.5 kN per square meter) requires no separate structural permit, but the lease must confirm floor-load compatibility through the building property certificate. Occupational health: a workplace hazard identification statement must be filed with the local health commission; no respiratory or chemical-exposure controls are applicable to binary middleware R&D workstations, and no civil-defense shelter obligation arises for a pure software-engineering office of this WFOE.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration of the People's Republic of China (国家税务总局, STA), exercised operationally through the provincial/municipal STA bureaus at the WFOE's registered domicile. Unified national filing portal: National Electronic Tax Bureau platform (全国统一规范电子税务局) at https://etax.chinatax.gov.cn. Tax–customs–foreign-exchange data is cross-matched through the Golden Tax Phase IV (金税四期) information system and the SAMR 'one-stop' (一网通办) registry integration.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: (1) Complete SAMR name reservation and obtain the foreign-invested WFOE business license; the 18-digit Unified Social Credit Code (统一社会信用代码, USCC) printed on the license is, by PRC law, the sole statutory TIN and VAT ID for all tax filings, e-invoicing, customs registration, and foreign-exchange settlement. (2) Tax registration is triggered automatically via the SAMR–STA real-time data exchange; the local STA must confirm the taxpayer type (general vs small-scale VAT taxpayer) and configure the e-invoice (数电票) quota within 10 working days of the license issuance. (3) Complete post-registration formalities: legal representative's and financial officer's real-name/face authentication with the STA, binding of RMB and foreign-currency settlement bank accounts, establishment of statutory accounting records, and submission of the cross-border service zero-rating/exemption filing (跨境应税行为零税率/免税备案) in respect of Taiwan-region gaming clients. (4) Taiwan-investor documentation (identity certificates or Taiwan MOEA company registration) must be certified under the cross-strait notarization and document verification system; the non-resident Taiwan holding company requires no separate PRC TIN.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation — the WFOE is a PRC resident enterprise under Enterprise Income Tax Law Article 2, taxed on worldwide income at the 25% EIT rate (reducible to 15% upon High/New Technology Enterprise or Technology Advanced Service Enterprise certification). The entity is a standalone VAT taxpayer: general taxpayer status is mandatory once annual taxable turnover exceeds RMB 5,000,000; otherwise small-scale status at a 3% collection rate may apply. No pass-through or transparent tax treatment exists for a WFOE LLC. Profit distributions to the Taiwan-region shareholder are subject to dividend withholding: the standard rate is 10% EIT withholding, reduced to 5% under the Cross-Strait Tax Agreement (2015) where the Taiwan beneficial owner directly holds at least 25% of the WFOE's equity and satisfies substance/bona-fide-holder conditions. Territorial scope: anti-cheat middleware and SaaS services supplied to Taiwan-based game publishers and wholly consumed outside mainland China are treated as offshore cross-border services; integration, installation, or support services performed inside mainland China remain within the VAT taxable territory and the EIT China-source income scope.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: PRC law does not provide a check-the-box regime. Available elections and elective treatments: (1) small-scale VAT taxpayer election for annual taxable turnover below RMB 5,000,000, with a VAT exemption for monthly sales not exceeding RMB 100,000; (2) per-transaction election between cross-border service zero-rating (0% output VAT with input-VAT refund under the exemption–offset–refund method) and pure VAT exemption (no output VAT, no input refund) under Caishui〔2016〕36号 Annex 4 and STA Announcement 2016 No. 29 — the zero-rating election is generally preferential for a refundable input-VAT base; (3) software-enterprise VAT immediate-refund election (即征即退): if the kernel-level anti-cheat engine is licensed as a self-developed software product at the 13% goods rate, VAT collected in excess of 3% is refundable; (4) EIT deemed-profit method (核定征收) in exceptional cases with STA approval where accounting is inadequate; (5) hybrid-mismatch adjustments under STA Announcement 2016 No. 42 are compulsory, not elective, and require arm's-length pricing and contemporaneous transfer-pricing documentation for all license/SaaS fees exchanged with the Taiwan group.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: PRC Value-Added Tax (增值税, VAT) — a unified national VAT administered by the STA, governed by the Interim VAT Regulations, Caishui〔2016〕36号 (service-sector expansion), and the PRC VAT Law effective 1 January 2026. Tax collection is fully digitalized with real-time e-invoice clearance.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Annual taxable sales (rolling 12 months or four quarters) exceeding RMB 5,000,000 (¥500万) makes general VAT taxpayer registration compulsory (STA Order No. 43 of 2018, codified under the VAT Law 2026). Below that threshold the WFOE may elect small-scale taxpayer status at a 3% collection rate; small-scale taxpayers with monthly sales ≤ RMB 100,000 are VAT-exempt (policy extended through 2027). General taxpayer registration is nevertheless strongly advisable for an export-oriented WFOE because only general taxpayers may claim input-VAT refunds on zero-rated cross-border services.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: All PRC VAT taxpayers must issue Fully Digitalized E-Invoices (数电票) in real time through the National E-Invoice Service Platform under Golden Tax Phase IV. Each invoice is validated by the STA at the moment of issuance (fiscal clearance at creation), with automatic cross-matching of e-invoice data, VAT returns, customs declarations, and foreign-exchange receipts; there is no physical fiscal stamping or legacy invoicing. Large-volume exporters may connect through the Tax–Enterprise Direct Link (乐企) API for machine-to-machine issuance and clearance. Under the 2026 VAT Law electronic invoices carry full legal effect and paper special VAT invoices are being fully phased out; any issuance attempted outside the authorized platform is blocked, and any mismatch between e-invoice data and cross-border zero-rating filings triggers an immediate tax-bureau audit alert.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Kernel-level anti-cheat middleware, SaaS integrity-monitoring subscriptions, and SDK license deliveries to Taiwan-based game publishers qualify for VAT zero-rating (0% output VAT with refund of attributable input VAT) where all of the following conditions are met: (a) the service falls within the zero-rated cross-border catalogue — 'software services' and 'information system services' — under Caishui〔2016〕36号 Annex 4; (b) the Taiwan recipient is a non-resident enterprise with no permanent establishment in mainland China; (c) the service is rendered and wholly consumed outside mainland China, which for remote server-to-server delivery from mainland hosting points to Taiwan gaming servers is accepted by the STA as qualifying; (d) the WFOE has filed the cross-border zero-rating/exemption registration (跨境应税行为零税率/免税备案) before the transaction month and issues compliant e-invoices naming the Taiwan entity; (e) input VAT attributable to zero-rated export transactions is segregated or fairly apportioned from domestic-sale input VAT and carried into the monthly exemption–offset–refund (免抵退) computation. Alternatively, the transaction may be classified as VAT-exempt (免税) with no refund; the zero-rating election is preferable whenever the WFOE holds material input-VAT credits.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (出口货物报关单) — required only where the anti-cheat firmware/SDK is embedded in tangible hardware or physical media physically exported across the border; pure SaaS and remote license/download delivery do not trigger a customs declaration
Bill of Lading / Airway Bill (海运提单/航空运单) — supporting physical shipment modality, where applicable

Inward Remittance Certificate (收汇凭证/银行结汇水单) — bank receipt evidencing settlement of the export consideration via Swift Wire or Stripe from the Taiwan-region client, matched to the e-invoice and contract
Cross-Border Service Zero-Rating / Exemption Filing Acceptance Form (跨境应税行为零税率/免税备案表)
Export Service Contract naming the Taiwan-region game publisher as recipient, defining software scope, license/SLA parameters, royalty metrics, and payment terms
Technical delivery evidence: server access logs, SDK entitlement issuance records, kernel-handover protocols, and acceptance certificates proving consumption of the anti-cheat service in Taiwan
Input VAT allocation schedule (进项税额分摊表) linking purchase invoices to the zero-rated revenue stream
Taiwan counterparty business registration certificate / Uniform Invoice Number for recipient due-diligence
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The STA and customs jointly audit zero-rating claims under the export-tax-rebate integrity system. Non-compliance triggers: mandatory clawback of all refunded VAT amounts plus daily late-payment interest of 0.05% (万分之五); administrative penalties of 0.5x–5x of the underpaid tax under Article 63 of the Tax Collection and Administration Law, and 1x–5x of the fraudulently obtained refund under Article 66; fines up to RMB 100,000 for false filings; revocation of the zero-rating/exemption filing and a 2–3 year blacklisting from future export-refund processing. Where fabricated contracts, inflated license fees, sham cross-strait arrangements, or artificial foreign-exchange round-tripping are detected, the STA may re-characterize the revenue as domestic taxable services at 6%, impose transfer-pricing adjustments with a 5-year lookback and interest, and refer criminal prosecution for fraudulent export-refund (骗取出口退税罪) under Criminal Law Article 204 — the criminal threshold begins at defrauded refunds above RMB 50,000, aggravated at RMB 500,000 and RMB 2,500,000, with penalties from 5 years' imprisonment up to life imprisonment plus fines of 1–5 times the amount fraudulently obtained. Compliance with the 180-day foreign-exchange repatriation deadline under SAFE administration and retention of the complete export substantiation bundle for the statutory recordkeeping period (generally 10 years) are indispensable defenses against retrospective clawback.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: People's Bank of China (PBOC) is the apex monetary and foreign-exchange administrative authority; the State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE), an operational bureau under PBOC, exercises delegated FX control through domestic-designated banks. For the Taiwan dimension, the Taiwan Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC) and the Taiwan Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA) Investment Commission govern outgoing investment into mainland China; cross-strait RMB clearing is executed under the 2012 Cross-Strait Currency Clearing Agreement with Bank of China Taipei branch as the Taiwan-side RMB clearing bank.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Chinese yuan (CNY) achieves de facto current-account convertibility for service-trade operations: software licensing proceeds and anti-cheat middleware subscription fees may be collected from or disbursed to overseas counterparties without case-by-case SAFE approval, subject to bank-led verification under SAFE cross-border monitoring systems and to the cross-border trade payment tax recordal procedure (对外支付税务备案) where the payment amount requires it. Capital-account items remain controlled: FDI capital injection, return of capital, equity transfer and foreign debt all require SAFE registration or filing obtained through the delegated bank, evidenced by the FDI Business Registration Certificate (业务登记凭证). Dividend and profit remittance to a Taiwan-resident shareholder is treated as a current-account debit for operational purposes but requires a closed verification chain: a statutory annual audit report, board resolution approving the distribution, a tax clearance or tax payment certification covering withholding obligations (including cross-strait tax treatment), and a valid FDI registration confirming the shareholder's equity chain. No separate SAFE approval is required at each dividend remittance once the bank has verified the above documentation package and the enterprise is not on any SAFE watchlist. Practical hurdles remain: capital-account RMB funds derived from voluntary FX settlement (意愿结汇) must observe the four-no usage prohibitions (no out-of-scope spending, no securities investment, no non-self-use lending, no non-compliant wealth management purchase); pilot-zone enterprises can rely on the Capital Account Income Payment Facilitation policy (资本项目收入支付便利化) to pay vendors directly from the settlement account; and any company-level offshore account holding of business revenue is prohibited without prior SAFE approval.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: China has abolished mandatory surrender ratios for export or service-trade foreign-exchange proceeds; the WFOE may retain earnings in its Foreign Exchange Settlement Account and convert voluntarily. Statutory repatriation and verification obligations nevertheless apply. For goods-bearing exports (anti-cheat hardware modules), the SAFE total-amount verification system generally requires export proceeds to be received within 90 days of customs release for A-class enterprises, extendable to 180 days with documented buyers-credit arrangements; non-collection triggers an overdue-receivables exception report to the verifying bank and, if unresolved beyond 365 days, administrative penalty exposure under PRC Foreign Exchange Administration Regulations Article 48 (fine of up to 30 percent of the unlawful foreign-exchange amount). For service-trade exports (software licensing, SaaS or anti-cheat engine subscriptions), there is no fixed statutory recovery window, but bank-side proportional monitoring applies: if contracted service revenue is not collected within 180 days from invoice issuance, the bank will flag the imbalance on SAFE's cross-border flow monitoring platform and demand a written justification, an aged-receivables schedule and a collection plan. All proceeds must ultimately be deposited in a domestic-designated account; parking operating receipts in offshore wallets without SAFE registration is a punishable violation under the same regime.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account: FX Capital Account under FDI registration; Operational Account: RMB Basic Deposit Account plus Foreign Exchange Settlement Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: China Merchants Bank Co., Ltd. (招商银行)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account: FX Capital Account; Operational Account: dual-currency current accounts with API-hosted cash-pooling and licensed cross-border payment aggregator settlement

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: China Construction Bank Corporation (中国建设银行)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account: FX Capital Account; Operational Account: RMB operating account and required service-trade current-account sub-accounts

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of Communications Co., Ltd. (交通银行)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account only: RMB basic account and FX settlement account; capital-account functionality requires transfer of existing SAFE FDI registration from the primary banking relationship

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-to-Medium for offshore digital EMIs (Wise, Airwallex, Stripe Treasury, Interstellar). Such entities cannot hold a PBOC-granted non-bank payment institution license and therefore cannot open a domestic payment account or function as the WFOE's primary onshore collection rail without a licensed Chinese banking partner; unlicensed cross-border collection would violate the PRC Foreign Exchange Administration Regulations and PBOC/SAFE cross-border payment-institution licensing frameworks. Viable architecture: the Taiwan parent (or a Hong Kong treasury vehicle) maintains the Stripe account and Airwallex multi-currency wallet; Stripe settles card receipts into that offshore treasury wallet; the treasury vehicle then wires the contracted intercompany consideration into the WFOE's Bank of China account via SWIFT MT103 with the correct service-trade purpose declaration. In this structure the EMI is an offshore treasury utility, not an onshore account provider, and stays compliant. Feasibility rating: Medium for the offshore-treasury model; Low for any model seeking direct onshore EMI settlement.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical appearance is mandatory for the WFOE's legal representative (or a mainland-resident authorized officer holding a notarized power of attorney) when opening the RMB Basic Deposit Account; PBOC Customer Identification Guidelines require a face-to-face anti-money-laundering interview with the legal representative or a formally delegated senior manager at the bank counter. For the FX Capital Account, Bank of China pilot branches operating under free-trade-zone or digital-banking pilots accept remote video opening with dual-officer verification, but non-pilot branches default to in-person attendance. The Taiwan-invested shareholder is exempt from physical appearance if the cleared KYC packet includes: (i) original or notarized Taiwan company registration and Taiwan unified business certificate; (ii) a certified board resolution authorizing the bank account opening and power-of-attorney; (iii) the Taiwan MOEA Investment Commission outbound investment approval for the mainland entity; (iv) director and ultimate beneficial owner identification documents with cross-strait residential address verification; and (v) a clean PBOC/CNIIS watchlist result for all statutory personnel. All directors and UBOs must declare any politically exposed person status; refusal or omission triggers automatic enhanced due diligence and refusal of account opening.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Gaming-adjacent activity red flag: the bank's AML classifier may tag video-game middleware as adjacent to gambling software, triggering enhanced due diligence and a Stripe payment-facility compliance freeze.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: SAMR business scope certificate coded to ISIC 6201/NAICS 541511; independent software classification opinion letter from a provincial internet security association confirming kernel-level anti-cheat functionality with no gambling nexus; customer-side declarations from AAA and casual game publishers confirming deployment in non-real-money titles; signed software subscription contracts with an express non-gambling warranty clause; and a commercial negative-media risk report from a licensed AML data vendor.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-strait beneficial ownership red flag: many domestic banks classify Taiwan-sourced capital as heightened regional scrutiny, requiring proof of genuine Taiwanese direct investment rather than transit or shell inflow.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Taiwan MOEA Investment Commission outbound investment certificate; group structure chart from ultimate individual UBOs to the WFOE; notarized articles of association and current shareholder registry identifying the Taiwan entity as direct subscriber; bank MT103 trail of the original paid-in capital remittance; SAFE FDI Business Registration Certificate; and a notarized statutory audit of the Taiwan parent for the two most recent fiscal years.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Intangible service royalty red flag: banks and SAFE may classify high-value software license flows as overstated service fees used to mask profit shifting or disguised dividend leakage.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: PRC software copyright or software registration certificate for the anti-cheat engine; R&D cost driver schedules with personnel and time-allocation records; transfer pricing benchmarking study applying the OECD transactional net margin method to intercompany licensing arrangements; the completed cross-border tax payment recordal certificate evidencing withholding settlement; and the annual statutory audit report with revenue segregation by product line.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume multi-jurisdiction inward remittance red flag: recurring small-ticket receipts from overseas game studios via Stripe or offshore wallets with tokenized subscription descriptions may fail beneficiary-matching checks and trigger payment-pattern alerts.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Master software subscription agreement schedule; Stripe settlement ledger mapped at individual customer-contract level; per-transaction service outcome evidence including SDK version deployment history and licensed-seat counts with timestamps; SWIFT GPI tracking records retained for five years; and a written cross-border payment compliance manual stating that each receipt is declared under SAFE service-trade classification for computer software services (classification 224020) with the corresponding invoice number embedded in the remittance reference field.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant sequence: (1) the Taiwan parent obtains Taiwan MOEA Investment Commission approval for the mainland software venture and files the outward-remittance authorization with its Taiwan bank; (2) the WFOE completes the combined SAMR/MOFCOM Foreign Investment Information Report, obtains its unified social credit code, and then secures the SAFE FDI Business Registration Certificate through the delegated Bank of China branch; (3) the WFOE opens the FX Capital Account in its own name at the same delegated branch and obtains the capital-account account number; (4) the Taiwan parent bank executes a SWIFT MT103 wire using purpose field code 622013 (foreign-invested enterprise capital injection) with the remitter stated as the Taiwan shareholder and beneficiary as the WFOE; alternatively, a cross-border RMB remittance via CIPS can be used with purpose code for FDI equity injection; (5) on receipt the delegated bank pairs the credit with the SAFE-registered FDI certificate number, verifies the remitter against the shareholder registry, and posts the funds to the FX Capital Account; (6) the WFOE exercises voluntary settlement (意愿结汇) into the Capital Fund Settlement-and-Payment Account, or, if the bank is a payment-facilitation pilot, applies the Capital Account Income Payment Facilitation regime to pay operating vendors directly; (7) the bank files all transactions to SAFE's cross-border capital monitoring system and the WFOE files the annual FDI information report through SAMR. Any intercompany loan from the Taiwan parent to the WFOE must be registered as foreign debt (外债签约登记) under the macro-prudential ceiling before remittance; an unregistered parent loan is unlawful and exposes both entities to administrative penalties and forced repatriation.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary clearing rail is domestic-bank SWIFT MT103 outbound wire from the WFOE's RMB or FX account to global suppliers such as cloud infrastructure providers, regional distributors and R&D subcontractors; payments exceeding USD 50,000 in service-trade consideration require the cross-border trade payment tax recordal certificate (对外支付税务备案) to be released by the bank alongside contract, commercial invoice and service-acceptance evidence. For receipts from overseas gaming studios using card rails, the compliant structure is: the Taiwan parent or Hong Kong treasury vehicle owns the Stripe account; card settlement aggregates into that offshore vehicle; and the vehicle pays the WFOE via SWIFT MT103 under a verified intercompany service agreement, with the WFOE declaring the receipt under SAFE service-trade classification 224020 (computer software services) or the applicable intellectual-property royalty class. For RMB-denominated settlement with Taiwan clients and distributors, clearing is executed through CIPS with Bank of China Taipei as clearing bank, which eliminates FX conversion and streamlines documentary compliance. For high-value deployment projects exceeding USD 250,000, documentary credit rails are available: an irrevocable sight commercial letter of credit in favor of the WFOE for milestone drawdowns against signed acceptance protocols; a standby letter of credit for advance-payment guarantee; and an outward usance letter of credit for overseas server-hardware procurement with deferred payment. Low-value global card receipts may additionally be channeled through licensed cross-border payment aggregators (LianLian, PingPong) into the WFOE's settlement account, provided each aggregate settlement batch is accompanied by an invoice-level declaration and retained on SAFE's cross-border flow monitoring platform.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore deliverable CNY/USD forward settlement and sale contracts (远期结售汇) executed at the WFOE's domestic bank under the real-demand principle, supported by projected licensing revenue and foreign-currency cost schedules.
CNY/USD foreign-exchange swaps (掉期) used for liquidity management of the FX Capital Account and the service-trade settlement account while maintaining full SAFE position limits.
Cross-currency swaps (货币掉期) for strategic hedging of long-dated three-to-five-year licensing contracts where revenues are USD-denominated and operating costs are RMB-denominated.

Plain-vanilla CNY/USD call and put options and combination structures (期权及组合期权) purchased from a licensed onshore bank, subject to the same real-demand documentation and quarterly effectiveness review.

Offshore non-deliverable forward (CNH NDF) positions are restricted to the Taiwan parent treasury vehicle; the onshore WFOE is not permitted to enter onshore NDF contracts. Any CNH NDF executed by the Taiwan parent must be reflected in the intercompany treasury agreement at arm's-length pricing with full audit trail, and the WFOE must not receive correlated payments under the Chinese domestic forward book because that would constitute unauthorized offshore hedge replication; instead, the WFOE covers underlying CNY/USD exposure exclusively through the registered onshore forward, swap or option program.

Cross-border RMB settlement substitution: rendering invoices and collecting subscription revenue in CNY from Taiwan and Hong Kong counterparties via CIPS is a permissible structural hedge that eliminates the underlying FX position entirely and reduces the required notional of derivative instruments.
